The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Nzela ya Ekulusu ebandaka na Fortelese Antonia, epai Bafransiskani babatelaka bandako-Nzambe ya Bobɛtami mpe ya Etumbu. Bato ebele ya mayele batiaka Pilato nde na ndako ya Erode pene ya Ekuke ya Yafa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Nzela ya Ekulusu, Engumba ya Kala ya Yerusalema
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Banda Ntango ya Katikati, bayengi-bisika-bisantu babondelaka Bisika ya Nzela ya Ekulusu na balabala oyo, banda Fortelese Antonia tii na Kalvere; mokolo nyonso ya mitano Bafransiskani bakambaka mobembo. Nzela ya solo Nkolo na biso alekaki etali esika Pilato akatelaki ye etumbu.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Baklisto bapesaka esika oyo lokumu banda bankola ya liboso; Mosantu Elena mpe Konstantino batongaki basilika likolo ya libanga ya Kalvere mpe lilita oyo ezalaki mpamba, mpe lelo Bafransiskani nde basalelaka yango.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka alobi mosika ya bastade ntuku motoba uta Yerusalema (Luke 24:13). Bisika misato epesamaka lokumu: Emaus Nikopolis, oyo emonisami awa; El-Qubeibeh, oyo Bafransiskani babatelaka; mpe Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Ndako-Nzambe ya Bokonzi bwa Mosantu Petro, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Ndako-Nzambe moke ya mabanga ya moindo na libongo ya mai, etongami zingazinga ya libanga oyo babengaka «Mensa Christi» (Mesa ya Kristu), epai, ndenge bonkoko elobaka, abongiselaki Bapostolo bilei ya ntongo.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Ndako-Nzambe ya Lilita ya Maria, lobwaku ya Kedroni
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Banda ekeke ya mitano to liboso, Eklezia ya Yerusalema epesaka lilita oyo lokumu na nse ya Ngomba ya Olive, pembeni ya Getsemani, lokola esika Mama ya Nzambe amemamaki na likolo. Abbaye ya Dormition na ngomba Siona ekundolisaka kolala na ye; bonkoko mosusu elobaka ete alekisaki mbula na ye ya nsuka elongo na Mosantu Yoane na Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Shapele ya Bomati na Likolo, Ngomba ya Olive
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka alobi ete amemaki bango «tii na Betania» (Luke 24:50), mpe Misala ya Bapostolo elobi ete bautaki na Ngomba ya Olive (Acts 1:12). Shapele moke na nsɔngɛ ebatelaka libanga oyo bapesaka lokumu lokola oyo ezali na elembo ya lokolo na ye ya nsuka.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Anzelu Gabriele apesi mbote na Bikira oyo atondi na ngolu. Ntango azongisi ete «esalema lokola olobi», Liloba akómi moto na libumu na ye.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria amemi Nkolo na biso epai ya ndeko na ye Elizabeti. Yoane abeti mabaku na libumu mpo na esengo, Elizabeti abengi ye «Mama ya Nkolo na ngai», mpe Maria ayembi Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Na engumba ya Davidi, Nkolo na biso abotami na Bikira Maria, bazingi ye na bilamba mpe balalisi ye na ebombelo ya bilei ya bibwele, mpamba te bazwaki esika te na ndako ya bapaya.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Anzelu asakoli «Mobikisi, Kristu Nkolo», mpe limpinga ya likolo eyembi ete «Nkembo na Nzambe na likolo». Babateli bakei noki koluka Mwana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Bato ya mayele bauti na ɛsti balandi monzoto na ye, bakuti Mwana elongo na Maria mama na ye, mpe bapesi ye wolo, mpaka-malasi mpe mire.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria na Yozefu bapesi Nkolo-Mwana. Simeoni akamati ye na maboko, abengi ye «pole oyo ekongengisa bikolo», mpe ayebisi Maria ete mopanga ekotobola motema na ye.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Lokola akebisamaki na ndoto, Mosantu Yozefu alamuki na butu mpe amemi Mwana na mama na ye na Ezipito, mosika ya loboko ya Erode, mpo ete liloba ekokisama: «Nabengaki mwana na ngai auta na Ezipito» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Ntango Erode akufi, Libota Mosantu efandi na Nazarete, mpe «mwana akolaki, azwaki makasi, atondaki na mayele, mpe ngolu ya Nzambe ezalaki likolo na ye».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Na mbula zomi na mibale, atikali na Yerusalema nsima ya Pasika. Na mokolo ya misato, Maria na Yozefu bakuti ye na katikati ya balakisi: «Boyebaki te ete esengeli ngai nazala na makambo ya Tata na ngai?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Mbula soki ntuku misato afandi na Nazarete, atosaka Maria na Yozefu, asalaka mosala ya mabaya, mpe akolaka na mayele, na molai mpe na ngolu liboso ya Nzambe mpe ya bato.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Yoane abatisi ye na Yordani. Likolo efungwami, Molimo Mosantu akiti lokola ebenga, mpe mongongo ya Tata elobi ete: «Oyo azali Mwana na ngai ya bolingo, nasepeli na ye mingi.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Molimo amemi ye na esobe, epai akilaka bilei mikolo ntuku minei mpe butu ntuku minei, mpe alongi komekama ya Satana na Liloba ya Nzambe.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Yoane alakisi ye: «Tala Mwana-mpate ya Nzambe.» Andele amemi ndeko na ye Simoni, oyo Yezu apesi nkombo Kefa, elingi koloba Petro; Filipo na Natanaele balandi ye.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Na liloba ya Mama na ye, «Bosala nyonso oyo akoyebisa bino», abongoli mai vino, elembo na ye ya liboso, mpe bayekoli na ye babandi kondima ye.
The Wedding Feast at Cana: Yezu amimonisi na libala ya Kana
To Jesus through Mary: Kokóma epai ya Yezu na nzela ya Maria
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Pasika ya liboso: molende mpo na ndako ya Tata
He drives the money changers from the Te: Abengani babongoli-mbongo na Tempelo mpe na butu ateyi Nikodemo ete esengeli moto abotama lisusu na mai mpe na Molimo. «Pamba te Nzambe alingaki mokili boye, apesaki Mwana na ye se moko.»
The Woman at the Well: Mwasi ya Samaria na libulu ya mai
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Lokola alembi na moi makasi, asengi mwasi moko ya Samaria mai ya komela, mpe apesi ye mai ya bomoi, «liziba ya mai oyo ebimaka mpo na bomoi ya seko». Bato ebele ya engumba na ye bandimi.
Healing the Official's Son: Kobikisa mwana ya mosali ya mokonzi
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Mosali moko ya mokonzi auti na Kafarnaumi abondeli ye aya. «Kende, mwana na yo azali na bomoi.» Na ngonga wana kaka mwana abiki.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Na sinagoga atangi na buku ya Yisaya, «Molimo ya Nkolo azali likolo na ngai», mpe alobi: «Lelo makomami oyo ekokisami.» Bato ya mboka na ye bamemi ye na nsuka ya ngomba, kasi aleki na katikati na bango mpe akei.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Bafransiskani bapesaka lokumu na Ngomba ya Kopumbwa na sudi ya engumba lokola ngomba oyo elobami na Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Ntango aleki Nazarete, afandi na Kafarnaumi pembeni ya laki, mpe abandi kosakola: «Ntango ekoki, Bokonzi bwa Nzambe bobelemi. Bobongola mitema mpe bondima Nsango Malamu.»
Repentance and trust in God: Bobongoli motema mpe kotia elikya na Nzambe
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Na libongo abengi Simoni na Andele, Yakobo na Yoane: «Bolanda ngai, mpe nakokómisa bino balobi ya bato.» Nsima ya kolobela mbisi ya likamwisi, batiki nyonso mpe balandi ye.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Ateyi na bokonzi na sinagoga, abengani molimo mabe na moto, atelemisi bokilo ya Petro oyo azalaki na fievre, mpe ntango moi elali engumba mobimba eyangani na ekuke.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Moto ya ekatakata mpe libiangi ya Matai
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Baninga bakitisi moto ya ekatakata na nzela ya motondo; Yezu alimbisi ye masumu mpe atindi ye atambola. Nsima abengi Levi, Matai, na esika ya mpako: «Landa ngai.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Ateyi Esengo, «Esengo na bato oyo bazali babola na molimo, mpo Bokonzi bwa likolo ezali bwa bango», mobeko ya sika ya bolingo, mpe libondeli ya Tata na biso.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Mokonzi ya basoda moko ya Roma alobi: «Nkolo, nabongi te ete okɔta na ndako na ngai, kasi loba kaka liloba moko.» Eklezia ezongelaka maloba na ye liboso ya kozwa Komunio na Misa nyonso.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Ayokeli mawa mwasi akufela mobali oyo azalaki kokunda mwana na ye se moko, asimbi mbeto ya ebembe: «Elenge mobali, nalobi na yo, telema!» mpe azongisi ye epai ya mama na ye.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Na feti moko na Yerusalema abikisi moto oyo azalaki na bokɔnɔ mbula ntuku misato na mwambe: «Telema, kamata mbeto na yo, mpe tambola.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Mopɛpɛ makasi etondisi bwato na mai, kasi ye azali kolala. Apameli mopɛpɛ: «Fanda nyɛ! Kita!» mpe kimya monene eyei. «Oyo azali nani, ete ata mopɛpɛ na mai bátosa ye?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Na ngambo mosusu abikisi moto oyo milimo mabe ebele ezalaki konyokola, mpe etindami na etonga ya bangulu. Moto yango abondeli ye ete alanda ye, kasi atindami kosakola makambo oyo Nkolo asalelaki ye.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Mwasi moko abiki ntango asimbi elamba na ye, mpe asimbi loboko ya mwana mwasi ya Yairo oyo akufaki: «Talita kum», elingi koloba: «Mwana mwasi, nalobi na yo, telema!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Na mampa mitano mpe mbisi mibale aleisi ebele ya bato, atali na likolo, apesi matɔndi mpe abuki mampa, mpe bayanganisi bitunga zomi na mibale etondi na biteni oyo etikalaki.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Na eteni ya nsuka ya butu ayei epai na bango na kotambola likolo ya laki. Petro atamboli mpo na kokutana na ye, abandi kozinda mpe agangi: «Nkolo, bikisa ngai!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Na sinagoga ya Kafarnaumi ateyi: «Ngai nazali lipa ya bomoi… Moto oyo alei nzoto na ngai mpe amɛli makila na ngai azali na bomoi ya seko.» Petro azongisi: «Nkolo, tokokende epai ya nani?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Mama moko mopaya abondeli ye mpo na mwana na ye ya mwasi: «Ata bambwa balei biteni oyo ekweyaka na mesa ya bankolo na bango.» «Mwasi, kondima na yo ezali monene!»
Ephphatha, and Four Thousand Fed: Effata, mpe koleisa bato nkoto minei
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Afungoli matoi ya moto ya matoi makufa, «Effata», elingi koloba «Fungwama!», mpe na mampa sambo aleisi nkoto minei oyo bafandaki na ye mikolo misato.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Bafarizeo na Basaduseo basengi ye elembo euti na likolo. Ayebisi bango ete bakozwa elembo mosusu te longola elembo ya Yona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Asimbi mokufi-miso na loboko, amemi ye libanda ya mboka, mpe atie ye maboko mbala mibale, tii amoni nyonso polele.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Kasi bino, bolobaka ete ngai nazali nani?» Petro azongisi: «Ozali Kristu, Mwana ya Nzambe ya bomoi.» «Ozali Petro, mpe likolo ya libanga oyo nakotonga Eklezia na ngai… Nakopesa yo bafungola ya Bokonzi bwa likolo.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Liboso ya Petro, Yakobo na Yoane, elongi na ye engɛngi lokola moi, Moize na Eliya basololi na ye, mpe Tata alobi: «Oyo azali Mwana na ngai ya bolingo… Boyoka ye.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Apameli bingumba epai asalaki bikamwa na ye ebele, Korazini, Betsaida mpe Kafarnaumi, mpo babongolaki mitema te.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petro amoni mpako ya Tempelo na monoko ya mbisi. Nsima Yezu atelemisi mwana moke na katikati na bango: «Soki bobongwani te mpe bokómi te lokola bana mike, bokokɔta te na Bokonzi bwa likolo.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Na lopango ya Tempelo ateyi: «Moto nyonso oyo azali na mposa ya mai aya epai na ngai amela», alimbisi mwasi oyo bakangaki na ekobo, «Kende, mpe banda sikawa kosala lisumu lisusu te», mpe asakoli: «Ngai nazali pole ya mokili.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Apakoli potopoto na miso ya moto oyo abotamaki mokufi-miso mpe atindi ye asukola na etima ya Siloe. Azongi amonaka mpe akumbameli ye: «Nkolo, nandimi.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marta ayambi ye, mpe Maria afandi na makolo na ye kolanda. «Maria aponi eteni oyo eleki malamu, mpe bakolongola yango epai na ye te.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Luka alobi kaka «na mboka moko»; Yoane alobi Betania lokola ndako ya Marta na Maria (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Ntango moko ya bayekoli asengi ye ateya bango kobondela, apesi bango libondeli ya Tata na biso.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luka alobi esika te; bonkoko bokundolaka yango na mobenga ya Eleona na Ngomba ya Olive. Matai apesi libondeli yango na Liteya na Ngomba (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Atamboli na mpondo ya Salomo na eleko ya malili, mpe alobi: «Bampate na ngai bayokaka mongongo na ngai… Ngai na Tata tozali moko.»
Azongi na esika Yoane azalaki kobatisa liboso. Ateyi ete oyo Nzambe asangisi moto akabola yango te, mpe apamboli bana: «Botika bana mike báya epai na ngai.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Ngai nazali lisekwa mpe bomoi.» Yezu alelaki na lilita ya moninga na ye, nsima agangi na mongongo makasi: «Lazaro, bima!» mpe mokufi abimi naino akangami na bilamba.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Ntango likita monene ekani koboma ye, amibombi elongo na bayekoli na ye na engumba moko pene ya esobe, Efraimi.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Mokufi-miso Bartimeo agangi: «Yezu, Mwana ya Davidi, yokela ngai mawa!» mpe amoni. Zakayo amati na nzete ya sikomore mpo na komona ye: «Lelo lobiko eyei na ndako oyo.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Mikolo motoba liboso ya Pasika, Maria apakoli makolo na ye mafuta ya nardo ya ntalo makasi, mpe ndako etondi na nsolo kitoko. Andimi yango lokola bopakolami mpo na bokundami na ye.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Akɔti na Yerusalema likolo ya mwana ya mpunda ntango ebele ya bato batandi bilamba mpe mampa ya mbila: «Hosana na Mwana ya Davidi! Apambolama oyo ayei na nkombo ya Nkolo!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Ntango amoni engumba, alelaki yango: «Soki yo mpe oyebaki lelo makambo oyo ekomemela yo kimya!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Abalusi bamesa, «Ndako na ngai ekobengama ndako ya libondeli mpo na bikolo nyonso», mpe akumisi mwasi akufela mobali ya mobola oyo apesaki mbongo na ye mike mibale ya nsuka.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Afandi na Ngomba ya Olive liboso ya Tempelo, alobeli bobebisami na yango mpe boyei na ye na nkembo: «Oyo bosalaki moko ya bandeko na ngai oyo ya mike koleka, bosalaki yango na ngai.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Asukoli makolo ya bayekoli na ye mpe, asimbi lipa mpe vino, alobi: «Oyo ezali nzoto na ngai… Kopo oyo ezali boyokani ya sika na makila na ngai… Bosalaka boye mpo na kokanisa ngai»; boye apesi Eklezia Ekaristi mpe bonganga-Nzambe.
The Agony in the Garden: Mpasi monene ya Yezu na elanga
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Na mpasi monene abondeli, mpe motoki na ye ekómi lokola matɔnɔ ya makila: «Tata… kasi lokola ngai nalingi te, kasi lokola yo olingi.» Yuda ayei elongo na ebele ya bato mpe atɛki ye na beze.
Before Caiaphas; Peter's Denial: Liboso ya Kayifa; bowangani bwa Petro
Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Akangami, bamemi ye epai ya Ana mpe ya nganga-Nzambe mokonzi Kayifa mpe bakateli ye etumbu ya kofinga Nzambe. Na lopango, Petro awangani ye mbala misato; soso elelaki, mpe Petro alelaki makasi.
Pilate finds no guilt in Him and sends H: Pilato amoni likambo te mpo na kokatela ye etumbu mpe atindi ye epai ya Erode, oyo atioli ye mpe azongisi ye. Ebele ya bato basengi Barabasi, mpe Pilato andimeli bango.
\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: «Bongo Pilato akamataki Yezu mpe abɛtisaki ye fimbo.» «Na bampota na ye tobikisami» (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Basoda batongi motole ya nsɔnɛ, balatisi ye elamba ya motane mpe batioli ye: «Mbote, Mokonzi ya Bayuda!» Pilato abimisi ye: «Tala moto!» mpe apesi ye mpo babaka ye na ekulusu.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Amemi ekulusu na ye, abimi mpo na kokende na Kalvere. Simoni ya Sirene atindami na makasi mpo na kosalisa ye, mpe alobi na basi oyo bazali kolela: «Bana basi ya Yerusalema, bolelela ngai te, kasi bomilelela bino moko mpe bana na bino.»
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Babaki ye na ekulusu na katikati ya basali-mabe mibale. «Tata, limbisa bango, mpo bayebi te oyo bazali kosala.» «Lelo okozala elongo na ngai na paradiso.» «Mama, tala mwana na yo… Tala mama na yo.» «Esili.» Agumbi motó mpe apesi molimo.
The Crucifixion and Death: Bobakami na ekulusu mpe liwa ya Yezu
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Yozefu ya Arimatea na Nikodemo bazingi nzoto na ye na bilamba ya lino elongo na malasi, mpe batie ye na lilita ya sika oyo batimolaki na libanga, na elanga pene ya esika babakaki ye na ekulusu.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Na mokolo ya liboso ya poso, lilita ezali mpamba. Nkolo oyo asekwi abengi Maria Magdalena na nkombo na ye mpe atindi ye epai ya Bapostolo: «Namoni Nkolo.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Bayebi ye te, atamboli na bayekoli mibale mpe alimboleli bango Makomami, mpe bayebi ye ntango abuki lipa. «Mitema na biso ezalaki kopela te na kati na biso?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Bikuke ekangami, atelemi na katikati ya Bapostolo mpe apemeli bango: «Bozwa Molimo Mosantu. Bato oyo bokolimbisa masumu, bakolimbisama», mpe nsima ya poso moko Toma ayamboli: «Nkolo na ngai mpe Nzambe na ngai!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Na ntongo pembeni ya laki atondisi minyama na bango mpe abongiseli bango bilei ya ntongo. Atuni Petro mbala misato: «Olingaka ngai?» mpe mbala misato apesi ye mokumba: «Bokɛngɛla bampate na ngai.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Na ngomba moko na Galilea atindi Zomi na moko: «Bokende bongo, bókómisa bikolo nyonso bayekoli, bóbatisa bango na nkombo ya Tata, mpe ya Mwana, mpe ya Molimo Mosantu… Mpe tala, nazali elongo na bino mikolo nyonso tii na nsuka ya ntango.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Matai alobi nkombo ya ngomba te. Bayengi-bisika-bisantu mingi bakundolaka yango na Ngomba ya Esengo; basusu bakanisaka Tabora to ngomba Arbel.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Mikolo ntuku minei nsima ya Pasika apamboli Bapostolo, alakeli bango Molimo Mosantu, mpe amatisami na likolo na miso na bango; bazongi na Yerusalema na esengo monene.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Mikolo ntuku mitano nsima ya Pasika, ntango Bapostolo bazalaki na libondeli na motema moko elongo na Maria, Mama ya Yezu, Molimo Mosantu akiti likolo na bango na minoko ya mɔtɔ. Petro asakoli Kristu oyo babakaki na ekulusu mpe asekwaki, bato soki nkoto misato babatisami, mpe Eklezia ekei na bikolo nyonso.
Wisdom and love of God: Mayele mpe bolingo mpo na Nzambe
The Assumption of Our Lady: Bomatisami bwa Bikira Maria na Likolo
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Ntango bomoi na ye awa na mokili esilaki, Mama ya Nzambe oyo azangi lisumu ya ebandeli, Bikira Maria libela, amatisamaki na nkembo ya likolo na molimo mpe na nzoto, ndenge Papa Pio XII asakolaki yango na 1950. Ye oyo abotaki Nkolo azali moto ya liboso oyo akabolaka lisekwa ya Mwana na ye.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Makomami elobi esika te. Emonisami na lilita epai Eklezia ya Yerusalema banda kala esepelaka bomatisami na ye na likolo.
Her Son crowns the Blessed Virgin Queen: Mwana na ye alatisi Bikira oyo apambolami motole lokola Mama-Mokonzi ya likolo mpe ya mabele, Mama-Mokonzi ya baanzelu mpe ya basantu. «Elembo monene emonanaki na likolo: mwasi oyo alati moi, sanza na nse ya makolo na ye, mpe na motó na ye motole ya minzoto zomi na mibale.»
This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Mistere oyo esalemaka na likolo; emonisami awa elongo na bomatisami na ye na likolo.
The Coronation of Mary: Maria atiamaki motole lokola Mama-Mokonzi ya likolo mpe ya mabele
Trust in Mary's intercession: Kotia elikya na bobondeli bwa Maria
Mondays and Saturdays, and the Sundays o: Mokolo ya liboso mpe ya motoba, Lomingo ya Adventi mpe ya eleko ya Noele
Tuesdays and Fridays, and the Sundays of: Mokolo ya mibale mpe ya mitano, Lomingo ya Karema
The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rozario ebotamaki na libondeli ya Eklezia. Ba-moine bazalaki koyemba nzembo 150, mpe baklisto oyo bayebi kotanga te bazalaki kobondela Tata na biso 150, nsima Mbote Maria 150, kotanga yango na nsinga ya mbuma: «Nzembo ya Maria».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Ndenge bonkoko eyebani elobaka, Bikira Maria apesaki Rozario na Mosantu Dominiko na Prouille, na Falanse, na ebandeli ya ekeke ya 13, mpo na kosalisa ye na liteya na ye mpo na kobunda na mateya ya lokuta ya Ba-albigeois. Lisangani na ye, Lisangani ya Basakoli, epanzaki yango na mokili mobimba ya baklisto, mpe na ekeke ya 15 Alano ya La Roche Mopambolami, Dominikani, azongisaki sika ezaleli oyo mpe abandisaki masangani ya liboso ya Rozario.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mosantu Papa Pio V, ye mpe Dominikani, apesaki Rozario lolenge na yango ya momesano ya mistere zomi na mitano, ya Esengo, ya Mpasi mpe ya Nkembo, na 1569. Nsima ya elonga ya Lepanto na 7 Ɔkɔtɔbɛ 1571, oyo bazwaki ntango mokili mobimba ya baklisto ezalaki kobondela Rozario, akómisaki mokolo yango feti ya Maria ya Elonga, lelo ekundoli ya Bikira Maria ya Rozario. Na Lourdes mpe na Fatima, Bikira ye moko ayaki na rozario mpe asengaki ete bábondela yango mokolo na mokolo.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Na 16 Ɔkɔtɔbɛ 2002, Mosantu Papa Yoane Polo II abakisaki mistere mitano ya Pole, euti na bomoi ya Nkolo na biso liboso ya bato, na mokanda na ye ya bopostolo Rosarium Virginis Mariae, mpo ete Rozario ezala «mokuse ya Nsango Malamu». Na mistere nyonso tokanisaka elongi ya Kristu na kotala na miso ya Mama na ye.
